facts.fact: AfDB says Niger completed provisional acceptance (ceremony 14 Nov 2025) of the 1,031 km national and cross-border fibre network built under the Trans-Sahara Optical Fibre Backbone Project, EUR 43 million, on five routes from Niamey and other towns to the borders; commissioning is called forthcoming by the minister.
